name: OpenAlex API
rate_limits: Credit-based system. Free tier: ~$1/day in credits. Singleton requests cost 1 credit, list queries cost 10 credits. Previously 10 req/s and 100k req/day. API key required since Feb 2025.
notes: 240M+ works indexed, 50k added daily. CC0 licensed data. Covers papers, authors, institutions, journals, concepts, funders, publishers. Supports filtering, grouping, sorting, and OR-syntax for batching up to 50 requests. Free API key available at openalex.org. Academic researchers can request higher limits for free. Successor to Microsoft Academic Graph.
